summary: Immunome filed an 8-K disclosing Amendment No. 4 to its 2017 license agreement with Bristol-Myers Squibb, terminating all milestone and royalty obligations and assigning patent rights for varegacestat (AL102) and AL101 to Immunome. Consideration was $20.0 million cash plus 4,425,487 newly issued common shares, issued under a concurrent stock issuance agreement. Immunome must file a resale registration statement by November 16, 2026, with effectiveness within 60 days. The structure removes a royalty overhang but adds BMS share overhang; watch registration timing, dilution, and any BMS resale pressure.
